entry_state: Chapter 3 is complete through physical 73. Literal source, supported interpretation and event-specific accounting permission remain separate. JPMorgan's 156 reference is retained as text but rejected as the report start; 163 is the supported navigation target, with no observed human decision. Coverage has three populations; nearest-rounding bounds require an admitted assumption. Public cutoff K and possession cutoff S filter different facts before revision selection. Bank commitment and insurance treaty corrections illustrate targeted supersession, candidate-population dependencies and complete-ancestry invalidation. Equal terminal cash cannot validate earlier recognition. Correcting an explanation does not alter committed journals; unsupported correction treatment creates no journal. Chapter 4 must now explain the distinct meanings of uncertainty in these retained alternatives.
exit_state: Chapter 4 is complete through physical 79. Accounting algebra separates conserved balances from permitted transactions; dynamic models motivate economic and behavioural state without supplying universal defaults. Shared unknowns and conditional tables preserve joint incomplete information; scoped certainty, provenance and public availability are distinct from posterior probability. Priors, model averaging and interventions add assumptions, and duplicate encodings must not gain mass. A typed library competes with a DSL; rule conflicts, supported alternatives and stochastic uncertainty differ. Table structure, PDF text assignment and financial meaning have separate evaluation targets; cropped-table TEDS and QA answers cannot establish whole-company accuracy. Solvers are bounded and inference remains optional. The synthesis hands the unresolved integration chain to Chapter 5 without claiming originality, empirical advantage or complete source coverage.
findings: No new confirmed rendered, transition or source-boundary defect on physical 74–79.
All eight Chapter 4 structural nodes have author judgments; there are no displayed equation nodes in this chapter. Primary-source truth is not newly certified by this reading.

chapters/03-literature.tex:chapter:1.entry_belief: Chapter 3 has separated literal evidence, admissible interpretations and permission to post corrections.
chapters/03-literature.tex:chapter:1.open_question: Which existing research supplies these distinctions, and which accounting-system capabilities still require a new design?
chapters/03-literature.tex:chapter:1.parent_contribution: The survey places algebra, incomplete databases, inverse inference, rule languages, extraction and solvers in different supporting roles.
chapters/03-literature.tex:chapter:1.belief_update: Adoptable ideas do not combine into a proven whole-company engine; missing primary texts and untested comparative performance remain explicit.
chapters/03-literature.tex:chapter:1.exit_question: What architecture can connect the supported pieces without erasing their different meanings of uncertainty and correctness?
chapters/03-literature.tex:chapter:1.removal_verdict: Removing the survey would hide both the borrowed foundations and the limitations that prevent asserting novelty or empirical advantage.
chapters/03-literature.tex:chapter:1.swap_verdict: Its placement after concrete evidence cases lets the reader evaluate each field against a visible problem before choosing the architecture.
chapters/03-literature.tex:chapter:1.entry_verdict: The opening promises a scoped design survey with source versions and technical anchors, rather than comprehensive coverage by assertion.
chapters/03-literature.tex:chapter:1.exit_verdict: The ending identifies the specific integration chain from disclosures to histories, events, journals and statements and hands it to the architecture.
chapters/03-literature.tex:chapter:1.promise_verdict: The seven sections give concrete imported ideas and explicit transfer limits; the four blocked originals remain qualifications, not inspected support.
chapters/03-literature.tex:chapter:1.distinct_contribution_verdict: This chapter explains why the proposed combination is a research and engineering choice rather than a theorem inherited from one discipline.

chapters/03-literature.tex:section:1.entry_belief: Financially different histories can share a closing statement, so conservation alone cannot select the transaction.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:1.open_question: What do accounting algebra and dynamic company models contribute beyond balancing entries?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:1.parent_contribution: Nehmer and Robinson supply conservation versus permitted transactions; dynamic models motivate separate economic and behavioural state.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:1.belief_update: Accounting DSL dates and corrections, accrual/payment accumulators, and capital-constrained bank choices are useful precedents with target-specific assumptions.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:1.exit_question: How can incomplete disclosures retain alternatives that no selected transaction log fully determines?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:1.removal_verdict: Without these precedents the proposal would conflate its new event and evidence vocabulary with results already established by accounting models.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:1.swap_verdict: This section precedes database semantics because the economic transitions being constrained must first be distinguished from report aggregation.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:1.entry_verdict: The opening names structured balances, transactions and aggregation and immediately explains why a balanced entry may still be inadmissible.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:1.exit_verdict: The final REA and stock-flow-consistent qualifications identify unavailable originals and the extra literature needed for a later multi-company equilibrium model.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:1.promise_verdict: The text cites specific sections for the inspected models while declining universal payment-delay, equity, funding or forecast defaults.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:1.distinct_contribution_verdict: It locates the economic-state requirement in prior accounting and company-dynamics work without treating their simplified models as whole-company evidence.

chapters/03-literature.tex:section:2.entry_belief: The historical representation preserves unresolved facts, source ancestry and several clocks.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:2.open_question: Which database results justify shared unknowns, certain statements and provenance, and where do their guarantees end?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:2.parent_contribution: Labelled nulls and conditional tables explain joint unknowns; provenance composition and temporal databases explain query ancestry and historical views.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:2.belief_update: Boolean certainty is scoped to a feasible family, independently certain rows may lose existential information, and dependency edges are not posterior probabilities.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:2.exit_question: What additional assumptions would turn a compatible family into probabilistic inference?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:2.removal_verdict: Deleting this section would leave shared symbols, certain-answer semantics and separate valid/store/public times without their conceptual sources or limits.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:2.swap_verdict: It follows accounting structure because database incompleteness concerns information about those economic states, and precedes probability to prevent conflation.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:2.entry_verdict: The repeated unknown repayment across a debt note and a cash-flow table makes conditional-table dependence concrete.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:2.exit_verdict: The temporal discussion adds public availability beyond stored-date semantics, retaining the difference between insertion and investor knowledge.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:2.promise_verdict: Libkin supplies the inspected technical argument; the blocked 1984 original is a backward lead, and positive semiring results do not cover negation or nonlinear valuation.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:2.distinct_contribution_verdict: It separates information incompleteness and explanation from financial uncertainty weights and from claims of exhaustive model scope.

chapters/03-literature.tex:section:3.entry_belief: A disclosure can restrict possible economic histories without identifying one history or assigning probabilities.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:3.open_question: What licenses a prior, model average or intervention instead of an unweighted feasible set?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:3.parent_contribution: The inverse-problem, robust-identification, model-averaging and causal references give distinct conditions for inference and scenario interpretation.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:3.belief_update: A flat likelihood cannot learn the unresolved conditional prior, duplicated encodings cannot gain probability mass, and an imposed stress is not historical conditioning.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:3.exit_question: How should the language expose these semantic choices and conflicting accounting rules?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:3.removal_verdict: Without this discussion an implementation could silently treat solver witnesses as posterior draws or interest-rate stresses as observational forecasts.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:3.swap_verdict: Probability follows incomplete-database certainty because optional weighting must be introduced as extra assumptions over the retained alternatives.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:3.entry_verdict: The observation relation y=G(u) connects the literature directly to the accounting reconstruction problem before discussing transfer limits.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:3.exit_verdict: The rates example gives the conditioning-versus-intervention distinction an economic consequence rather than leaving it as terminology.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:3.promise_verdict: The text preserves the mixed/discontinuous-model limitation on Stuart, the working-version anchor for Giacomini and Kitagawa, and the need for priors and likelihoods.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:3.distinct_contribution_verdict: It identifies the assumptions that probability and causal scenarios add; none follows merely from reproducing financial statements.

chapters/03-literature.tex:section:4.entry_belief: Alternative facts and probabilities require explicit meaning, while accounting rules may also contain defaults, exceptions and conflicts.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:4.open_question: Does a new DSL add useful constraints beyond an ordinary typed application library?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:4.parent_contribution: The language literature supports shared typed representation, explicit conflict outcomes and compositional contract state independently of syntax.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:4.belief_update: A library remains a serious competitor; Catala correctness is not correctness of AccDSL rules, and LegalMath candidate generation does not prove complete history search.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:4.exit_question: Can document-extraction components supply the evidence needed by those typed contracts?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:4.removal_verdict: Removing the competitor and semantic distinctions would turn the choice of a DSL into an unsupported premise and confuse legal defaults with stochastic uncertainty.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:4.swap_verdict: The language choice comes after the semantics it must preserve and before the extraction methods expected to populate it.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:4.entry_verdict: The section starts with the library option in the DSL decision tree, avoiding an assumption that a parser is the product.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:4.exit_verdict: Contract combinators and ACTUS separate obligations and cash flows from complete-book recognition, measurement and presentation.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:4.promise_verdict: Python API and text syntax share one representation; imported rule/compiler and contract ideas retain exact limits instead of certifying accounting applicability.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:4.distinct_contribution_verdict: It makes language and contract reuse conditional on semantic needs, rather than on a preferred implementation technology.

chapters/03-literature.tex:section:5.entry_belief: A typed economic and accounting model still needs faithful source structure, text and contextual meaning.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:5.open_question: Which document and financial-QA results support ingestion, and what do their reported scores actually measure?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:5.parent_contribution: Table datasets, Docling, TableFormer, reasoning benchmarks and the auditable-RAG competitor establish different extraction and evidence-processing tasks.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:5.belief_update: TableFormer predicts structure and cell boxes while PDF text supplies content; TEDS on cropped PubTabNet tables is not whole-filing accounting accuracy.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:5.exit_question: Which solver and inference machinery can operate on the admitted accounting representation?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:5.removal_verdict: Without this section a plausible table or a correctly answered financial question could be mistaken for a complete multi-period history or validated journal generator.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:5.swap_verdict: It follows the contract/language account because extraction quality must be judged against the source-linked records those contracts require.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:5.entry_verdict: PubTables canonicalisation and GriTS introduce detection, structure and function as separate evaluation units before naming reusable components.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:5.exit_verdict: The RAG competitor contributes persistent provenance and recovery, while the text expressly records that no comparative performance experiment has run.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:5.promise_verdict: The supplied-PDF-content TEDS values 95.4, 90.1 and 93.6 retain their task/population boundaries, and code versus model rights remain separate.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:5.distinct_contribution_verdict: It translates extraction and reasoning evidence into specific ingestion candidates while preserving the gap to accounting interpretation.

chapters/03-literature.tex:section:6.entry_belief: Faithful evidence and explicit semantics do not by themselves provide a tractable solving or inference procedure.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:6.open_question: What computational capability is justified by the solver and probabilistic-programming references?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:6.parent_contribution: Z3 motivates a bounded logical/exact-linear fragment, while Stan, Pyro and probabilistic programming motivate optional inference over a separately defined economic model.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:6.belief_update: Unsupported formulas remain visible; exact accounting identities and discrete rule choices cannot be weakened into penalties just to fit an inference library.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:6.exit_question: How can these supported but limited components be combined into the proposed company-history system?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:6.removal_verdict: Without these restrictions a successful SMT call or sampler execution could be reported as exhaustive exploration or valid nonlinear accounting simulation.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:6.swap_verdict: Solver choices come after evidence, uncertainty semantics and language requirements because those define the problem a backend is allowed to solve.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:6.entry_verdict: The first paragraph names finite choices and exact linear arithmetic before discussing inference tools, giving the computational fragment a visible boundary.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:6.exit_verdict: The closing rejects both near-satisfied accounting identities and a claim that sampler success means every interpretation was explored.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:6.promise_verdict: No general nonlinear tractability or posterior-validity result is asserted from a software architecture citation.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:6.distinct_contribution_verdict: It assigns computation to a declared fragment and keeps scientific validity separate from tool execution.

chapters/03-literature.tex:section:7.entry_belief: The surveyed disciplines each supply a partial solution with distinct assumptions and evidence limits.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:7.open_question: What remains to be designed after these precedents are acknowledged?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:7.parent_contribution: The concluding disclosure-to-history-to-event-to-journal-to-statement chain defines the integration problem the next chapter must address.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:7.belief_update: The proposal has local mathematical constructions and a planned comparison, but originality and empirical advantage are not established by this survey.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:7.exit_question: Which architectural responsibilities preserve these distinctions while allowing compatible implementations?
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:7.removal_verdict: Removing this conclusion would leave a list of useful sources without explaining the specific unresolved combination or its evaluation obligation.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:7.swap_verdict: The synthesis belongs after all six contributing literatures so it can state what their combination still does not establish.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:7.entry_verdict: The opening collects the actual contributed concepts before describing their required interaction.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:7.exit_verdict: The final sentence points to acceptance cases, accounting review and Chapter 14 comparative work as the basis for future practical merit.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:7.promise_verdict: The section closes the survey promise while leaving originality, performance and product validity at their actual unestablished status.
chapters/03-literature.tex:section:7.distinct_contribution_verdict: It turns the literature review into a concrete architecture question without inventing a novelty or superiority verdict.
